nodes.help: Name what you needed, hoped, agreed, or were expected to do.

nodes.prompt: Did I know what effective behaviour was needed or expected?
What got in the way of knowing?
nodes.help: Describe the missing information, unclear expectation, or skill gap.
What could help you get the information, clarify the expectation, or learn the skill?

nodes.title: Repair the knowledge link
nodes.body: Use the problem-solving plan before the next opportunity. The worksheet stops here for this branch.

nodes.prompt: Was I willing to do what was needed?
What got in the way of wanting to do what was needed?
nodes.help: Describe the competing urge, cost, belief, or consequence that mattered.
What could increase willingness or address the obstacle?

nodes.title: Repair the willingness link
nodes.body: Use the problem-solving plan before the next opportunity. The worksheet stops here for this branch.

nodes.prompt: Did the thought of doing what was needed ever enter my mind?

nodes.help: What cue, reminder, routine, or environmental change could bring the behaviour to mind next time?

nodes.title: Repair the remembering link
nodes.body: Set up the cue or reminder before the next opportunity. The worksheet stops here for this branch.

nodes.prompt: What got in the way of doing it right away?
nodes.help: Describe the specific link between remembering and acting.
What could remove, reduce, or work around that obstacle?

nodes.title: Repair the action link
nodes.body: Practice the problem-solving plan at the next opportunity. The worksheet stops here.
